messages.body:
Hi Bronwen,

Attached is the table plan, final final version (I promise!). The changes from last week are mostly names: we have renamed the tables after Welsh lakes instead of trees, so Table 1 is now Llyn Padarn and so on down to Llyn Tegid by the dance floor. Kwame's grandmother needs to be near the door and out of any draught, so she has moved from Llyn Ogwen to Llyn Padarn with Mum and Dad, and the university crowd are all together on Llyn Brianne now.

The place cards will come with the florist on Friday morning, already in table order, with the menu choices printed small on the back so the waiting staff can see them. Could someone check the spelling of Ifeoma's surname on the card for Llyn Celyn? I think the printer dropped a letter.

Auntie Grace is so excited. She will arrive about 1pm with the minibus from the hotel, and she'll need the ramp at the side entrance and a table near it.

Music: the band will set up from 4pm and want the side door propped open for their gear. They'll sort themselves out with Hattie, I think Kwame spoke to her last week about where they eat.

Lastly, Dad wants to say a few words before the meal rather than after, if that's allowed. Is that OK with the kitchen timings?

Speak soon, and thank you for everything,
Ruth
